verdict.rationale: Linear documents checkpoint-based rollback for coding-agent sessions ("restore to any previous checkpoint from version history") and Guided Reviews for diffs, but these apply to code changes rather than to the automations/Loops themselves; there's no explicit documentation of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back a Loop's own definition or schedule/trigger config. missing for 10: version history specifically for Loop/automation definitions, review workflow for automation changes, rollback of an automation's trigger/schedule config rather than just code output.
